# BizYour

> BizYour (bizyour.in) is a business management app by DILIGENCE for Indian
> shops and small businesses: billing, stock (inventory), udhaar (customer
> credit), GST reports, and a built-in B2B wholesale marketplace called
> Business Mart — all in one app, with one login, one subscription and one
> data set.

## What it is

- **Workspace**: the shop-management side — GST billing with WhatsApp bill
  sharing (PDF), stock management, purchases, customer udhaar ledger,
  supplier payments, expenses, estimates and returns, a monthly business
  report card, and a ready GSTR-1 file for the CA.
- **Business Mart**: a B2B bazaar inside the same app where businesses buy
  from wholesalers and distributors. An order received in the Mart
  automatically becomes a purchase and updates stock. Business Mart is
  **free forever** for every business.
- **Pricing model**: Business Mart is free. Workspace is free for the first
  30 days (no card needed), then a paid plan; if the plan lapses the data
  stays visible and exportable in read-only mode — nothing is deleted.
- **Languages**: English, Hindi and Hinglish on every screen.
- **Works offline** for billing; data syncs when the connection returns.
- Runs in the browser on phone, tablet or computer — no installation and
  no computer required. Staff get their own logins with role limits.

## Who it is for

Kirana and general stores, mobile and electronics shops, and other
goods-selling businesses (garments, hardware, electrical, cosmetics,
footwear, gift and stationery), plus wholesalers and distributors who
supply them.

## Who builds it

BizYour is built by **Team DILIGENCE** — IITians based in Delhi, India.
It is not a faceless corporate product; it is built line by line by a
small team that can actually be reached.
